Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence & sample artifacts for TruPay onboarding

Hi Grace,

We're wrapping up TruPay's vendor onboarding and need a concise package of BCP/DR evidence tied to your SOC 2 & SIG answers. Our security team is specifically asking for: 

- RTO and RPO commitments (for hosted API and Dedicated deployments) with recent test results
- Evidence of automated backups (snapshots) and retention windows with timestamps
- A copy of your DR runbook or a read‑only link + owner contact
- Recent DR test report (within the last 12 months) and outcomes
- An attestation statement we can include in our registry

Can you send a short worksheet populated with the above items and any attachments (logs/snapshots) or point us to a shared folder? Ideally by end of week so procurement can close the security review.

Thanks,
Danielle
Danielle Smith
Vendor Risk Manager — TruPay Systems

Hi Danielle — thanks for the clear list. Happy to help. Quick answers up front: 

- High-level commitments: Hosted API: RTO \u003c= 30 minutes for control plane failover; RPO \u003c= 5 minutes for customer state. Dedicated: RTO \u003c= 60 minutes (depending on region failover policy); RPO \u003c= 15 minutes. (I'll include the attestation text below.)
- We run incremental snapshots every 5 minutes for KV and ledger state; full daily snapshots retained 30 days by default (configurable for enterprise).
- DR runbook (read-only link) and last tabletop/DR test summary attached.

Attaching a worksheet (ServiceContinuity_Worksheet_Gridded_v1.xlsx) that maps your checklist to artifacts. Also attaching a two-page DR_Summary_2026Q3.pdf with test outcomes.

Two clarifying Qs before I populate everything: 1) Do you need encryption/KMS proof (e.g., KMS key id and rotation cadence)? 2) Which environment(s) should we focus on — hosted API only or dedicated/private as well?

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Reliability & Ops
